description: Gets one public design shared on breadboardhub by its owner's username and its slug, both shown in search results and in design links (breadboardhub.com/<username>/<slug>). Use this when the person shares a breadboardhub design link or picks a design from search results. Returns its name, type, description, licence, tags, simulator, its circuit when it has one, and link. Free, with no daily limit.

slug.description: The design's slug, as in breadboardhub.com/<username>/<slug>.

username.description: The design owner's username, as in breadboardhub.com/<username>/<slug>.

name: get_design
title: Get a design
